new='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    centers = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 and all(0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == 2
                for rr, cc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1))):
                centers.append((r,c))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i, (r1,c1) in enumerate(centers):
        for r2,c2 in centers[i+1:]:
            if r1 == r2 and c1 != c2:
                lo, hi = sorted((c1,c2))
                if all(grid[r1][c] == 0 for c in range(lo+2,hi-1)):
                    for c in range(lo+2,hi-1): out[r1][c] = 1
            elif c1 == c2 and r1 != r2:

                if all(grid[r][c1] == 0 for r in range(lo+2,hi-1)):
                    for r in range(lo+2,hi-1): out[r][c1] = 1
    return out
'''
